findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, second reading
findings.note: Member's page lists his vote as Aye on second reading (chamber tally 66-47). The bill text (sixth edition, https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2025/Bills/House/PDF/H958v7.pdf) would have county boards process a voter registration only if it affirmatively states the applicant is a citizen, would have a process to remove voters flagged as possible non-citizens from a federal database, and would have deceased-voter list checks.
